name: vestigial-pair-activation-is-llama-config
written_before: any code. Reach measured over all 109 cached plans after wave 7.
the_fix: Two keys read by no implementation, ours or upstream, checked against transformers 5.5.0 by exact-word grep: Falcon3-1B-Base declares `activation: swiglu` beside `hidden_act: silu` under `model_type: llama` (LlamaConfig has no `activation`); SmolLM2-135M declares `is_llama_config: true` under `model_type: llama` (no hit anywhere). Same treatment as PR #375's `use_mrope` / `rope_interleaved`: read-and-check against the EFFECTIVE policy, never echo. `activation` agrees only when the built FFN is gated with the declared gate activation (swiglu == gated silu); `is_llama_config` agrees only when the resolved family is llama. A checkpoint declaring `activation: gelu` or `is_llama_config: false` under a llama stack refuses.
why_not_the_cluster: ffn_activation has reach 26 and unclustered reach 59; these two keys reach exactly one row each.
note: Rebased on the wave-8 baseline before the code was written; the original text was written against wave 7 and said to add wave 8's deltas.
falsifiers: either key found to be read by a transformers 5.5.0 loader after all

result.verdict: EXACT. Also checked at whole-model granularity: the blocker SET changed on exactly these two rows, so the path-to-component fix that rode along (a bare leaf ending in `_config` is a root key, not a section) moved nothing else across 109 plans.
result.controls: Both VINDEX3 tests run before the rules existed failed with class Unknown; after the rules but before the parser stored the keys they failed as `read by nothing in any registered parser` — the consumed-key contract holding — and pass once the parser reads them. Full 117-row re-plan on the semantics-8 binary.
result.fix_as_landed: `activation` → ExecutionSurface.ffn.{ffn_type, activation} through one two-way table in larql_models::config::activation (`swiglu` = gated SiLU, `geglu` = gated GELU, a plain name = ungated); `is_llama_config` → the registry entry the declared identity resolved to, via ProbeContext.family. Both stored on ModelConfig and credited as consumed, like use_mrope.
result.defect_found_on_the_way: `component_of` read any first segment ending in `_config` as a component section, so `is_llama_config` was sent to a component named `is_llama` that the graph never builds. A section is a segment with something after it.
